# Gateway routes with no entry in kiro_crew.dashboard.route_access.ROUTES, as
# `<METHOD> <path pattern>`, sorted by path, then method. A HEAD route beside a
# GET route of the same path has no row: it takes the GET route's label.
# test/test_route_access_labels.py fails on any OTHER registered route without
# an entry, so this list can only shrink.
#
# Do NOT add a line to make a red test green: give the new route an entry in
# ROUTES (docs/system-specs/modules/route-access.md says how to pick its action
# name and tier). When a listed route gains an entry, or is removed, delete its
# row in the same change.
